sthr-hour-2.name: Hour II — Low Water
sthr-hour-2.text: When reached: each investigator draws 1 encounter card.

sthr-hour-3.name: Hour III — The Thirteenth Toll
sthr-hour-3.text: When reached: raise Dissonance by 1. If any investigator is at a Church location, raise it by 2 instead. If the log shows "The Thirteenth Toll," skip the extra +1.

sthr-hour-4.name: Hour IV — The Road Gives Way
sthr-hour-4.text: When reached: the location with the fewest clues becomes impassable until the next Hour; investigators there move to a connecting location (that move is a Skip). If the log shows "The Hour Was Wrong," remove this Hour from the Occultation entirely.

sthr-hour-5.name: Hour V — The Streets Empty
sthr-hour-5.text: When reached: each Sleepwalking Echo awakens if Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher. The Appointed's Approach advances to at least Sensed.

sthr-hour-6.name: Hour VI — The Wrong Sky
sthr-hour-6.text: When reached: add 1 [skull] Static token to the chaos bag until the next reset. If the log shows "What the Almanac Hid," instead each investigator removes 1 Static token.

sthr-hour-7.name: Hour VII — The Guest Approaches
sthr-hour-7.text: When reached: the Appointed's Approach advances to at least Emerging. If the log shows "The Latecomer's Name," it enters play exhausted.

sthr-hour-8.name: Hour VIII — Almost
sthr-hour-8.text: When reached: raise Dissonance by 2. The Appointed's Approach advances to Arrived. All enemies get +1 fight until the next reset.

sthr-hour-9.name: Hour IX — The Appointed Hour
sthr-hour-9.text: When reached: the night ends. Trigger a reset. If the log shows "The Way the Night Breaks," you may attempt the finale instead.

sthr-losthour.name: Lost Hour
sthr-losthour.text: Revelation — Skip: advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour. If the Hourglass is at Hour VI or later, advance it by 2 instead.

sthr-slippage.name: Slippage
sthr-slippage.text: Revelation — Add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round. Surge.

sthr-waitingcongregation.name: The Waiting Congregation
sthr-waitingcongregation.text: Sleepwalking. While Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher, the Waiting Congregation gains Hunter. Prey — the investigator with the most Memory.

sthr-drownedchoir.name: The Drowned Choir
sthr-drownedchoir.text: Sleepwalking. Aloof. Forced — When the Drowned Choir awakens: each investigator at its location takes 1 horror.

sthr-familiarface.name: Familiar Face
sthr-familiarface.text: Sleepwalking. Spawn — engaged with the investigator with the most Memory. Forced — When Familiar Face is defeated: that investigator places 1 Memory on their investigator card.
sthr-familiarface.flavor: You will remember this face too.

sthr-lamplighterecho.name: The Lamplighter's Echo
sthr-lamplighterecho.text: Sleepwalking. While the Ambergrove Lamp is in play, this enemy loses Sleepwalking and gains Retaliate.

sthr-wrongturn.name: Wrong Turn
sthr-wrongturn.text: Revelation — Each investigator moves to a connecting location of the lead investigator's choice. This move is not a Skip and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
sthr-wrongturn.flavor: The map is not where you left it.

sthr-rewind.name: Rewind
sthr-rewind.text: Revelation — Return the most recent clue you discovered this round to its location. If you have discovered no clues this round, instead take 2 horror.

sthr-deadair.name: Dead Air
sthr-deadair.text: Revelation — Add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of your next turn. Until then, Static tokens are treated as -4 instead of -3.

sthr-loopnotices.name: The Loop Notices You
sthr-loopnotices.text: Revelation — Raise Dissonance by 1. If you have played a Recollection or triggered a foreknowledge ability this round, raise it by 2 instead.

sthr-yearinanight.name: A Year in a Night
sthr-yearinanight.text: Revelation — Test [wil] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. If you fail, increase your Years by 1 (apply any bracket change at the next interlude).

sthr-forgotten.name: What You've Forgotten
sthr-forgotten.text: Revelation — Remove 2 Memory from among your cards. For each Memory you cannot remove, take 1 horror instead.

sthr-oldbones.name: Old Bones
sthr-oldbones.text: Revelation — If you are Elder or Ancient, take 2 damage; otherwise take 1 damage. If you are Elder or Ancient and have no [com] or [agi] icons in hand to commit, take 1 additional horror.
sthr-oldbones.flavor: Your body remembers what your mind won't.

sthr-crossing.name: The Crossing
sthr-crossing.text: Revelation — Advance the Appointed's Approach by 1 stage (to a minimum of Sensed). Then raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-loc-square.name: The Square
sthr-loc-square.flavor: Everyone is out for the occultation. None of them will look at you twice — not this time, not ever.

sthr-loc-almanacsteps.name: The Almanac Steps
sthr-loc-almanacsteps.text: Objective — If 5+ total clues have been gathered, an investigator here may resolve the Occultation (no test).

tokens.text: -1. If Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher, -2 instead.
-2. If you fail, raise Dissonance by 1.
-3. If the Appointed is Sensed or later, take 1 horror.
-4. If you fail, advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour.

sthr-loc-lanternroom.name: The Lantern Room
sthr-loc-lanternroom.text: Objective — With 4+ clues discovered in this district, test [com] or [wil] (3) here to light the lamp. Success: record "The Lamp Was Never Lit."

sthr-loc-keepersquarters.name: The Keeper's Quarters
sthr-loc-keepersquarters.text: Deep objective (Act II, lamp lit) — Spend 2 clues from here to read the keeper's logbook. Record "The Keeper's Ninth Death."

sthr-darkthatwaits.name: The Dark That Waits
sthr-darkthatwaits.text: Revelation — If you are at the Lantern Room, take 2 horror; otherwise take 1 horror.

sthr-loc-belfry.name: The Belfry
sthr-loc-belfry.flavor: The bell tolled thirteen times. The thirteenth is the sound the night is stuck on.

sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.name: The Flooded Crypt
sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.text: Sealed until the log shows "The Thirteenth Toll." Deep objective — Recover the drowned almanac-page (3 clues here). Record "The Hour Was Wrong."

sthr-loc-vestry.name: The Vestry
sthr-loc-vestry.text: Objective — With 6+ clues discovered in this district, read the register here. Record "The Thirteenth Toll."

sthr-thirteen.name: Thirteen
sthr-thirteen.text: Revelation — Skip: advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour. If you are at a Church location, also raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-risingwater.name: Rising Water
sthr-risingwater.text: Revelation — The location you are at gets +1 shroud until the end of the round.

sthr-loc-turning.name: The Turning
sthr-loc-turning.text: Objective — Move Turning → Bridge → Milestones (reverse of the Echoes), discovering 1+ clue at each. Record "The Road Remembers." Deep objective (Act II) — evade or Hold an awakened Echo here and read the face beneath the hood. Record "Who Walks Beside You."

sthr-bridgeremembers.name: The Bridge Remembers
sthr-bridgeremembers.text: Revelation — If you crossed the Low Bridge this round, Skip: advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour. Otherwise, draw 1 encounter card.

sthr-loc-townhallsteps.name: The Town Hall Steps
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.text: Once the log shows "The Sheriff Is Already Dead": once per loop, an investigator here may look at the top card of the Occultation deck.

sthr-loc-recordsoffice.name: The Records Office
sthr-loc-recordsoffice.text: Deep objective (Act II) — Find the ledger (3 clues here). Record "The Vote That Never Ends."

sthr-loc-well.name: The Well
sthr-loc-well.text: Objective — With 5+ clues discovered in this district, examine the body here. Record "The Sheriff Is Already Dead."

sthr-samespeech.name: The Same Speech
sthr-samespeech.text: Revelation — Take 1 horror, plus 1 more for every 3 completed loops (max +3).
sthr-samespeech.flavor: He has been dead since ten o'clock. No one has noticed but you.

sthr-crowdturns.name: The Crowd Turns
sthr-crowdturns.text: Revelation — Each Echo in play readies. If no Echo is in play, this gains Surge.

sthr-loc-wheel.name: The Wheel
sthr-loc-wheel.text: Objective — Test [agi] (3) here to ride the Wheel. Success: discover 2 clues from any location in this district and record "The Wheel Still Turns."

sthr-loc-ticketbooth.name: The Ticket Booth
sthr-loc-ticketbooth.text: Deep objective (Act II) — Speak with the ticket-taker. Record "The Ticket-Taker's Bargain."

sthr-wheelsturn.name: The Wheel's Turn
sthr-wheelsturn.text: Revelation — Skip: advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour. Then each investigator gains 1 resource.

sthr-reflectionlies.name: Your Reflection Lies
sthr-reflectionlies.text: Revelation — If you are at the Hall of Mirrors, take 2 horror and add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round; otherwise take 1 horror.

sthr-loc-press.name: The Press
sthr-loc-press.text: Objective — With 6+ clues discovered in this district, set the Press to reprint the true time. Record "What the Almanac Hid."

sthr-loc-sealedstudy.name: The Sealed Study
sthr-loc-sealedstudy.text: Sealed until the log shows "What the Almanac Hid" and "The Vote That Never Ends." Deep objective — Recover the name (3 clues here). Record "The Latecomer's Name." The finale is declared here.

sthr-pagethatwasnt.name: The Page That Wasn't
sthr-pagethatwasnt.text: Revelation — Take 1 horror for every 6 banked Memory (round up, max 3).
sthr-pagethatwasnt.flavor: In one loop she found a page that was not there in the others.

sthr-inkrunsbackward.name: Ink Runs Backward
sthr-inkrunsbackward.text: Revelation — Cancel the next clue that would be discovered this round at your location.

sthr-studydoor.name: The Study Door
sthr-studydoor.text: Revelation — While the Sealed Study is sealed, add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round. Otherwise, this gains Surge.
